proportion_source.pixel_ratios: Clean-photo alpha: 998 px wide x 1118 px tall including the raised lever. The candidate keeps the same gross proportions at about 0.68 m overall height. The lever angle differs between the photo/front-back reference panels and the left/right reference panels, so a single consistent pose is inferred.

bottom.note: The bottom reference panel shows a ribbed underside and a central cast boss. The rib count and the shallow central recess are read from that uncalibrated panel; the recess is not a through-hole.

lugs.note: Two small cast ears with steel pins under the collar are visible as tabs in the reference back/left panels; their exact purpose and hidden form are inferred.

mechanism.lever_note: The photo shows a green hollow rectangular-section bar with an open far end; the six-view reference draws it as a round pipe in some panels. The candidate follows the photo's rectangular bar.

knob.note: Bright green plastic pull/lock knob with a visible central recess; its exact function and axis are inferred.

mechanism.note: The crank/gear housing, side plate, bolts, link and knob follow the visible lower-side assembly. The photo shows the mechanism in a three-quarter view; hidden gear internals and the far side of the housing are inferred.

handle_loop.note: The photo shows the loop attached to the body on the same visible side as the raised lever mechanism, between the mechanism and the label. The candidate mounts it at azimuth 310 deg with its plane containing the radial direction and Z. The reference front/back panels draw it on the opposite side and are treated as mirrored. Hidden body-side mounts and the small upper pin are inferred.

label.note: Label artwork is recreated from the legible photo text; the original artwork, small print, certification marks and exact wording are not reproduced.

emboss.note: The raised 5T mark is visible on the photo's lower body. The font and exact relief are inferred.

note: The six-view sheet is an uncalibrated visual-match reference generated for comparison, and its panels are not a consistent turntable (the lever is drawn at different angles). The clean/rust photo is the primary shape evidence. Hidden faces, hole depths, threads, the gear internals and the exact cast rib layout remain inferred.
